build_PipelineDataset: build a PipelineDataset to wrap a dataset with a process function and params for inference
create_PipelineIterator: create a PipelineIterator to apply an inference function over a data loader with optional batch unrolling
test_PipelineChunkIterator: test a PipelineChunkIterator to flatten nested preprocess iterators into a single stream
run_PipelinePackIterator: run a PipelinePackIterator to re-aggregate unbatched items into original process boundaries using is_last markers
build_KeyDataset: build a KeyDataset to extract a single key from each item of an underlying dataset
